detail.longDescription:
Apparently, some TLS servers will fail if they can't receive the ClientHello if it spans multiple packets and therefore requires multiple read() calls to fully receive.

https://tldr.fail/

What manner of…how did they even manage to screw up this badly??? It's TCP! We've been using it for like 50 years! It is literally a museum piece! There was literally never any guarantee that a message would come through in a single read()! There is no excuse for this!

🤦‍♂️

#programming
